title: Deploy targets
description: Per-environment instance targets and channel grants for the deploy-layer skills. Identity only: what concrete thing fulfills each adapter slot, and what the tooling may do about it. Never runtime values or secrets.

schemaVersion.description: Format version of this file. Exactly one supported value.

environments.description: Map of environment name to its target rows.

environmentEntry.description: One environment's targets, keyed by adapter-type slot.

targetRow.description: One target: the concrete instance an environment's slot points at, plus the channel grants a skill may exercise against it.

provider.description: The kind of instance this row identifies.

project.description: Declared identity: the Railway project name. Verified, never rewritten.

environment.description: Declared identity: the Railway environment name. Verified, never rewritten.

service.description: Adopted identity: the Railway service name, recorded from platform output.

reconcile.description: May skills propose writes through Railway's control plane?

verify.description: May skills probe this instance's data plane?

instance.description: Declared identity: the Clerk instance name (e.g. development, production). Verified, never rewritten.

application.description: Adopted identity: the Clerk application id, recorded on first contact.

reconcile.description: May skills propose writes through Clerk's control plane (the session claims merge)?

verify.description: May skills probe this instance's data plane (JWKS fetch, token mint)?
